concept: A slider is a thin track with a white knob held by the finger; the knob is large enough to grab and the hit area larger still.

root.why: label and current value sit above the track, so the reader sees what they are changing before touching it

head.why: one line with the name at the start and the value at the end, read left to right

label.why: the visible label is also the accessible name of the thumb

value.why: the current value in tabular figures and secondary colour, so changing numbers do not jitter

slider.why: the 44px tall root is the hit area, much larger than the 6px track you see

track.why: the track is the quiet fill with a ring, a groove in the pane rather than a coloured bar

range.why: the filled part uses the accent, the only colour on the control

thumb.why: a white 20px knob with ring and shadow, visible on both themes and on glass

data-disabled.why: disabled keeps the slider visible at half opacity and stops dragging

hover.why: the knob grows slightly under the pointer, inviting the grab

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared ring with its halo so the focused control is visible on any scene

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours draw the track, range and knob with system colours so the value stays visible

transform.why: the knob grows over the hover duration, a small settle rather than a jump
